title: gatewatch: constitution changed without recorded human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 7c9f6f982c632c92edf07d4592f2f7b4ed3c1c87, docs/CONSTITUTION.md lines 1-142 (new file). Article IX requires explicit human review for changes to the constitution; no explicit human sign-off or seed tracker reference is present in the repository history/seed queue. This merged change therefore bypassed the mandate-protection requirement.

title: gatewatch: audit triggers changed without recorded human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit ecf40e74f3e120649817350ddfca9241e9407a95, .warren/triggers.yaml lines 1-47 (new audit trigger entries and prompts). Article IX requires explicit human review for changes to audit entries in .warren/triggers.yaml; no explicit human sign-off or seed tracker reference is present in the repository history/seed queue. This merged change therefore bypassed mandate protection.

title: gatewatch: governance workflow title has constitution-only diff
description: Evidence: commit 7c9f6f982c632c92edf07d4592f2f7b4ed3c1c87, subject 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions), with no automated workflow file changed. Article I requires merge subjects/descriptions to describe their diff truthfully; the title claims automated-workflow standardization that is absent from the merged diff.
